title: Ash and Tally
subtitle: The Tollhouse Intercept
summary: Rowan's militia and Orsen's ward smiths block the mountain toll road and recover the diverted iron and grain convoy.

c9_start.speaker: haldor
c9_start.text: Roll two empty wagons across the narrow stone bridge. No bloodshed unless they draw steel first—those drivers are guild teamsters under false orders.

c9_road_blockade.speaker: rowan
c9_road_blockade.text: Halt the lead mules! Look at the iron crates under those tarps—every ingot still bears Orsen's Outer Ward foundry mark!

c9_torrik_read.speaker: torrik
c9_torrik_read.text: Teamsters—look at the Council audit writ and the lockhouse book! Quartermaster Fennick forged your manifests to sell winter iron across the border!

c9_check_lockmaster.speaker: nova
c9_check_lockmaster.text: The lead wagoner recognizes the lockhouse clerk's own handwriting in your ledger—they're dropping their reins and uncoupling the caravan.

c9_peaceful_surrender.speaker: orsen
c9_peaceful_surrender.text: Not a single bolt fired. Sixteen iron-and-grain carts recovered intact—and the drivers agreed to testify before the Council.

c9_tense_standoff.speaker: rowan
c9_tense_standoff.text: Fennick's hired outriders bolted down the ravine when they saw Haldor's pikes. Two carts overturned, yet twelve full wagons are ours.

c9_village_return.speaker: selva
c9_village_return.text: The road belongs to the wards again. Now take those recovered manifests back to the High Quarter and finish what you started, Torrik.
